cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of official-runtime-setup-guide (path-1-and-2-setup-instructor) with contract handoff to path-one-host-outline
cases.inputPrompt: Use official-runtime-setup-guide to walk a user on Blender 5.1 with Claude Desktop through configuring Path 1 (installing the Blender Lab MCP add-on inside Blender 5.1+ first, then enabling the Anthropic Connector host).

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (selected_runtime_path) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces step_by_step_setup_prerequisites, path_version_and_host_boundary_notes, readiness_verification_handoff for role path-1-and-2-setup-instructor
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to path-one-host-outline (Path 1 host (a)/(b) details)
forbiddenOutputProperties: Anthropic Connector works standalone without add-on
evidenceRequirements: Outputs step_by_step_setup_prerequisites, path_version_and_host_boundary_notes, readiness_verification_handoff conforming to skills/official-runtime-setup-guide/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to path-one-host-outline in skills/official-runtime-setup-guide/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete step_by_step_setup_prerequisites and hand off to path-one-host-outline (Path 1 host (a)/(b) details).
simulatedOutput.summary: Provided step-by-step Path 1 setup walkthrough (Blender 5.1+ Lab MCP add-on installation first, followed by host configuration) with explicit confidence labels and zero execution claims. Delivered Blender 5.1+, Blender Lab MCP add-on, not standalone and routed to path-one-host-outline.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

Routes to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver (Bridge conflict resolution) without claiming runtime execution

evidenceRequirements: Contract fallback handoff predicate match to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow fallback handoff to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver (Bridge conflict resolution).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered fallback handoff from official-runtime-setup-guide to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver under context {"runtime.conflictDetected":true}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in official-runtime-setup-guide
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during official-runtime-setup-guide with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for official-runtime-setup-guide and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for official-runtime-setup-guide.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (selected_runtime_path) for official-runtime-setup-guide halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Give me the exact MCP runtime setup steps without telling me what Blender version, operating system, or AI host client I am using.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'selected_runtime_path' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing installed Blender version, operating system, and MCP host client required by official-runtime-setup-guide (selected_runtime_path)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: installed Blender version, operating system, and MCP host client
forbiddenOutputProperties: Anthropic Connector works standalone without add-on
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'selected_runtime_path' (installed Blender version, operating system, and MCP host client)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing installed Blender version, operating system, and MCP host client (selected_runtime_path) before official-runtime-setup-guide locks step_by_step_setup_prerequisites.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted official-runtime-setup-guide due to missing required input 'selected_runtime_path' (installed Blender version, operating system, and MCP host client); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent installed Blender version, operating system, and MCP host client when 'selected_runtime_path' is omitted.

expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/official-runtime-setup-guide/contract.json when to install or configure a runtime automatically
Delegates to runtime-path-picker (Delegates out-of-scope requests to runtime-path-picker) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
forbiddenOutputProperties: Anthropic Connector works standalone without add-on

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for official-runtime-setup-guide (to install or configure a runtime automatically); delegate to runtime-path-picker.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced official-runtime-setup-guide exclusion boundary (Delegates out-of-scope requests to runtime-path-picker) and delegated to runtime-path-picker.
